Within the Tides Quest

General

Aliases

Marapur Quest

Quest Log

Within the Tides Quest

Requirements

Premium

✓

Other

Version

12.90.12182
July 18, 2022
Summer Update 2022

Status

Active
See also: Quests

Legend

Tarun has noticed the Asuri seem to visit a far away place from time to time. Will you help him investigate it?

Location

Asura Palace, Marapur

Dangers

Jungle Moas, Parders, Foam Stalkers, Two-Headed Turtles, Naga Archers, Naga Warriors, Makaras, the Archfoe bosses The Moonlight Aster, The Winter Bloom, The Flaming Orchid, Kusuma and Timira the Many-Headed.

Reward

Access to Marapur, Colourful Water Lily (used to tame a Giant Beaver), a Lilypad Backpack, a Naga Nest and the Wedding Planner achievement.

Click to show/hide the quest spoiler.
(settings)
Spoiler • edit


Requirements

  • Completed The Lost Brother Quest
  • Helmet of the Deep or Depth Galea
  • Mountainous Matters mission
    • Hammer
    • Some Ice Cubes
    • One Honeycomb
    • A Mango and a Juice Squeezer

Method

Of Feathers and Flowers

To begin, head to the northeast area of Tiquanda around here (32976, 32715, 7) and speak with Tarun. Ask him about the Asuri, and he will explain that these vile demons sometimes visit a faraway place. Tarun, curious but unwilling to investigate himself, will ask for your assistance.

Mission Objectives

After accepting Tarun's mission, your goal is to explore the palace and obtain three feathers by defeating the following minibosses:

  • The Flaming Orchid drops the Flamingo Feather.
  • The Moonlight Aster drops the Peacock Feather.
  • The Winter Bloom drops the Swan Feather.

In order to acquire them, you need to defeat three Asuri minibosses: The Flaming Orchid, The Moonlight Aster, and The Winter Bloom. Note that you don't have to kill or loot the items if someone can lend you the feathers; having one of each feather is sufficient for any number of players. You may bypass looting the Flamingo Feather and Peacock Feather by purchasing these items on the marketplace. However, the swan feather available on the marketplace is not the correct one needed for the "Golden Hand Location." Therefore, you must defeat the The Winter Bloom boss to loot the proper Swan Feather.

All three minibosses are located within rooms behind sealed doors. To access them, you need to eliminate specific non-Asuri creatures in the palace. The requirements are:

  • The Flaming Orchid: 2x Greater Fire Elementals (here (32960, 32676, 4)) and 3x Cave Hydras (here (32940, 32679, 8)).
  • The Moonlight Aster: 2x Vicious Liches (here (32923, 32680, 8)) and 2x Vile Destroyers (here (32936, 32687, 5)).
  • The Winter Bloom: 2x Greater Energy Elementals (here (32961, 32673, 7)) and 1x Solitary Frost Dragon (here (32943, 32664, 8)).

Once you're done with these and have all feathers in hand, go upstairs (32956, 32674, 3) and find an Ornate Case. Use it to get a Parchment then go downstairs towards Gilmak Copperbeard and ask him about the nagas. He'll tell you where to find three treasure chambers to build an artefact that grants you access to a portal high in the Kha'zeel Mountains.

The three parts of the artefacts are in the following locations:

NOTE - You will need to have the 3 feathers in your backpack inventory in order for the locations to appear and be opened on the floor.

  • Silver Hand: Ankrahmun (Here (33279, 32785, 7))
  • Golden Hand: Folda (Here (32082, 31528, 7))
  • Bronze Hand: Edron (Here (33266, 31768, 10)) (Must first get the handwritten message from here (33270, 31734, 10))

Once you have the parts, simply use the items on each other until you have a completed Asuri Talisman. Finally, head to Kha'zeel Mountains between Tiquanda and Ankrahmun to step in the portal (here (33037, 32738, 2)) where you'll then be teleported to Marapur.

Coastal Concerns

The Nagas at the coast may be in need of some help, but they'll only help you if they know you have good will.

Cure for the Beavers

Once in Marapur, head west from the Silvertides depot and talk to Dhira. Ask him for a mission and he will ask for your help to cure many giant beavers that help the island by harvesting and transportation. Accept the task and he'll ask you to gather a Moon Mint and a Coral Branch.

  • Moon Mint can be harvested from Moon Mint plants in the Fading Isles. The nearest one is here (33632, 32801, 7).
  • Coral Branch can be looted from Foam Stalker in the Great Pearl Fan Reef, down here (33743, 32779, 7).

With both items in hand, walk to a building just south of the Silvertides depot, here (33771, 32855, 7). In the laboratory, use your Coral Branch in the Mortar located on a table west in the room and you'll obtain Coral Powder. Then go east and use your Moon Mint and Coral Powder in the Refiner of Magic. If done correctly you'll obtain a Cure for Sick Beavers.

Report back to Dhira then head just north from him to talk to Nilavarna.

Hunt Foam Stalkers

Ask Nilavarna for a mission and he'll ask you to kill a total of 300 Foam Stalkers and Two-headed Turtles. Walk to the west island of the Stardance Mountains with a Helmet of the Deep or a Depth Galea, then jump in the vortex to Great Pearl Fan Reef once again.

With the 300 kills achieved, report it back to Nilavarna and he'll give you a new task to help Timira as she suddenly became irascible and aggressive. Go to the northeast subarea of Emerald Gardens to find a portal to the boss fight.

Timira the Many-Headed

Go to the small portal located in a house at the Emerald Gardens, here (33803, 32701, 7). This fight can be fought by up to 5 players, and you have 10 minutes to defeat Timira.

Stage 1 - Sparkles

On the first stage, you have to use the special water to heal the Shattered Water in the room. Pick up an Empty Bucket from the floor and wait until the water starts to glimmer. When it does, use the bucket on the water to fill it. Make sure you're next to the water or the bucket won't be filled. You should get a Bucket Full of Sparkles . Then, use the bucket on the Shattered Water on the eastern wall of the room.

While doing this, you'll constantly have to deal with Corrupt Nagas and Rogue Nagas, which quickly respawn in the room. You can try to block them or run around them or simply kill them while doing the mechanic.

If you get a Bucket Full of Water by mistake, just empty the water on the floor so you can reuse your bucket. You have to use four buckets for each player in the room, but it doesn't matter who uses them. Once you're done, an energy effect will appear across the room. Then, click on the Trapped Water to use its energy to open the portal to the next stage. Enter the portal to the south. Make sure to open the Ornamented Chest near the portal for an extra reward!

Stage 2 - Corrupted Water

Similar to the previous stage, you have to use the trapped water to open the portal. This time, however, all you have to do is use the Corrupted Trapped Water until its cleansed and becomes Trapped Water, which you can use to open the portal. You can only use the corrupted water once every 30 seconds, so you'll have to deal with the Nagas while you wait.

Be careful, you lose health and mana when you successfully use the Corrupted Trapped Water.

Once the portal is open, make sure to open the chest to the north and move to the final room.

Stage 3 - Timira

Now you'll finally face Timira the Many-Headed! There are no mechanics here, and all you have to do is kill her. You can trap the boss in a corner north-west of the room to make the fight easier.

After killing the boss talk about your mission to Nilavarna. He will reward you with Colourful Water Lily.

Mountainous Matters

The Mountain Nagas also have some problems they need help with.

Fix the Observatory

Go southeast from the Moonfall subarea's depot and upstairs in a big building until you find Udu at the last floor (here (33849, 32788, 2)). Ask her for a mission and she'll tell you she needs help with her observatory as something is blocking the water-powered mechanism downstairs in the same building.

Go downstairs until you find a water wheel. In this room, walk north to use the lever to slow it down, then use a Hammer on the water wheel to fix it and get a quest log update.

Report back to Udu, and continuing with the mission she'll ask you to find an important piece of her telescope, the Glass Lens, which was stolen by a moa and hidden in a nest. To find the nest, you have to go to the west part of Stardance Mountains, close to where prince Nihaka is, and use a Jungle Moa Nest located a bit south from there (here (33717, 32777, 2)).

Bring the lens back to Udu, and as a part of the mission, she'll give you a Celestial Chart . She'll ask for your help to find three constellations on her celestial chart: The Turtle, The Southern Crab, and The Smaller Rose. In order to chart these constellations, you'll have to visit the specific sites on the island and "use" your Celestial Chart, as described below:

Note: you can only chart the constellations at night!

Constellation Location Server Log
Turtle
Here (33716, 32677, 5)		 You chart the Turtle constellation: Eight stars that form the shape of a two-headed turtle just over the Northern horizon.
Southern Crab
Here (33876, 32817, 6)		 You chart the Southern Crab constellation: Sixteen bright stars that form a crab appear low on the Southern horizon.
Smaller Rose
Here (33747, 32786, 2)		 You chart the Smaller Rose constellation: Ten dim stars, rising from the Western horizon, form the shape of a rose.

Report back to Udu to complete the Observatory mission.

Stolen Naga Eggs

Note: To finish this mission you must have helped Udu, but also completed the Star-Crossed Lovers mission below. You should now jump to that part of the quest and return here once you have finished it.

Find Saraki (here (33722, 32765, 4)) for a new mission. She will tell you the Asuri have stolen some naga eggs and ask you to talk to Kaumudi, the hatch-mother who is in charge of the eggs.

Kaumudi doesn't have much information to assist you. She asks you then to talk to shaman Vrisaki, so you can go straight to him.

Vrisaki is located on top of a mountain (here (33780, 32735, 2)). Meet him and ask about the naga eggs. He will ask you three items to protect you from the Asuri on your search for the eggs:

  • Parder Fur, loot from Parders.
  • Canary Feather. Go to Candra and pick the feather from the bird cage near her. (You must have completed the Star-Crossed Lovers task for that.)
  • An Ice flower carved from Ice Cube. You can use the Icicle Chisel you'll receive to carve the Ice Cubes. You need either Pretty , Beautiful or Marvelous Ice Flowers .

With all 3 items go back to Vrisaki and use them on the Stony Face near him.

Secret Room

Talk to Vrisaki about naga eggs once more, he'll tell you about a vision and stolen eggs in a secret room deep down in the sunken temple of the Moon Goddess.

Bring the Gemmed Lotus Brooch (from the Kusuma's room) and go to the second floor of the sunken temple. Use the brooch on wall here (33627, 32776, 9) and then use the wall to enter the room.

Use the big stone located north in the room and you'll find a hidden Bag with Naga Eggs there.

Bring the eggs back to Kaumudi and tell her about your mission. You'll receive a Naga Nest as a reward.

Return to Saraki at the mountain to report your mission success. She will ask you for help with Timira the Many-Headed. If you have already defeated her during the Coastal Concerns mission then you don't have to do it again. Just say mission once more to complete the quest.

Star-Crossed Lovers

Note: You should only start this mission after having finished Coastal Concerns and the Observatory part of Mountainous Matters, otherwise you won't be able to progress.

Go up the stairs twice in the coastal palace to find Candra, here (33729, 32828, 4). To help Candra and Nihaka get married you need to go talk with Candra first and ask for a mission. She says to talk with shaman Tarisu. He can be found on the temple south-east of Silvertides, here (33797, 32858, 6).

Talk with the Naga Shamans

Tarisu believes the people will benefit from this marriage. If you haven't started the Coastal Concerns mission yet, he'll ask you to first Cure the beavers. He also tells you to talk with Vrisaki, the mountain nagas' shaman.

Vrisaki can be found at Moonfall's temple, just north of the depot up 3 sets of ramps, here (33779, 32734, 2). He wants you to help Udu first, which means you also need to have started the Mountainous Matters mission.

After having helped both Udu and Dhira on the other missions, you can talk to Vrisaki and Tarisu once again. Depending on the order you did the missions, you may have to ask each NPC about mission twice.

The Four Good Omens

Each of the Shamans asked you for two good omens to prove that this marriage is not ill-fated.

Tarisu wants a vial of holy water from the pond on our cemetery island and a moonshine pearl. Vrisaki wants a coral vow flower and a damselfly.

  • Blessed Water

Go up the ramp on the eastern side of the eastern ramp, here (33781, 32722, 7). Follow the path south-east until you find a Pile of Dry Wood. Use it to get a Splint.

Then go back north and turn left to the other path of this passage, go south until you find a fireplace. Use the splint on it to make a Burning Splint.

Finally, go to a small island all the way north-east of Marapur, here (33792, 32674, 7), where you'll find a frozen pond. Using the Burning Splint on it to melt the water, and then use the water to receive a vial with Blessed Water.

  • Moonshine Pearl

To get this pearl, go to the eastern side of Marapur and down a vortex here (33883, 32740, 7). You'll need to wear a diving helmet. Use the Large Seashell to get the pearl.

Note: If you're doing this mission with more players you'll have to wait 1 minute for the pearl to respawn for the other players.
Note²: Initially Tarisu will tell you the pearl is at the Temple of the Moon Goddess, where you'll find a Large Seashell (Shimmering) and a Shimmering Pearl. This is not the real pearl, however, but you can only take it during this mission of the quest. If you wish to have it, you should take it before the real pearl.

  • Living Damselfly

Go to Nihaka at the Mountain, here (33721, 32770, 3), and ask her about damselfly to get an empty Butterfly Conservation Kit.

Go to the Big Naga Statue between Silvertides and Moonfall, here (33703, 32809, 5). You'll be informed that someone has killed all the damselflies.
Someone has killed all the damselflies! Just some legs and eyes and broken wings are scattered here.
Report back to Nihaka and he'll suggest luring more damselflies with honeyed mango juice. Use a Juice Squeezer on a Mango to get a Flask of Mango Juice . Then use the flask on a Honeycomb to make a Flask of Mango Honey Juice .

Use the Honey Juice on the water of the pond to spawn some Emerald Damselflies, and use the Butterfly Kit on a living Damselfy to catch it. You should end with a Butterfly Conservation Kit containing a Damselfly.

  • Coral Vow Flower

You'll need Foam Stalker Spume , which is a guaranteed drop from the Venerable Foam Stalker, a special Foam Stalker that can be found here (33762, 32778, 9).

With the spume, go to the mountain at the Murmuring Wilderness, here (33738, 32682, 5). Use the spume on the ground next to a Burnt Coral Vow Flower and pick the Coral Vow Flower .

Return to Candra and give her the Pearl and the Blessed Water.

Go to Nihaka and give him the Damselfy and the Flower.

Kusuma

The final task is to defeat Kusuma, an Asura that was disguising herself as a Naga. You can find her on the western mountain, here (33716, 32767, 5). You can enter the room by stepping on the Energy Vein symbol near the wall.

After defeating her, open the chest and take the Gemmed Lotus Brooch from it.

After that you can report back to Nihaka or Candra, you'll receive a Lilypad Backpack and the Wedding Planner achievement.
